dataset.title: Ores and metals exports (% of merchandise exports) (latest)

indicator.name: Ores and metals exports (% of merchandise exports)
indicator.description: Ores and metals exports as a percentage of total merchandise exports.

source.name: World Bank, World Development Indicators (TX.VAL.MRCH.MT.ZS)
source.citation: World Bank WDI TX.VAL.MRCH.MT.ZS, underlying UN Comtrade / WITS. Table transcribed and uploaded to this repo (data/raw/uploads/world_bank_ores_and_metals_exports_share_2025_latest.json).

notes: Auto-imported from an uploaded "most recent value" table: each entity keeps its own latest year (0–2025), so old observations sit next to recent ones.

World Bank aggregates are skipped; blank cells stay missing (never zero). Observations older than 2010 are not used (they were 1975–2008 for a few economies such as Somalia, Chad and Equatorial Guinea).
caveats: Share of merchandise exports: shows how much an economy earns from this product group, not how much it depends on imports. Context only.

scoring.rationale: Export composition is context (exposure to world prices), not dependence on others.
